struct@(A,B) Pair {
  x: Int@A;
  y: Int@B;
}

func@(A,B) main() {
  let pairs = [Pair@(A,B) { x: 10, y: 20 }];
  let i = 0;
  if true@A {
    pairs[i].x = 30;
  }
}
